investigation.finding: Aspose.Epub does NOT exist as a standalone NuGet package
epub_support_in_aspose: Aspose.Words can import/export EPUB (Aspose.Words.LowCode — already covered in words family)
Aspose.HTML handles ePub as part of HTML document processing
No dedicated Aspose.LowCode namespace for EPUB has been released

resolution.rationale: Aspose.Epub NuGet package does not exist (404). No standalone Aspose EPUB product with LowCode namespace is available. EPUB is handled by Aspose.Words as a conversion output format — already covered in the words family.
resolution.taskcard_action: CLOSE_TC: epub reflection blocker is resolved by reclassification. No further action.
